start: ^We followed him all the way from the Jordan. They say he is the one promised to break the yoke. But the soldiers are watching like wolves.

s: ^Do you think he has come to fight Rome?
^What did you see him do in Galilee?

perspective: ^He speaks of a kingdom, but his hands hold no iron. We will see.
signs: ^I saw five thousand men sit on a hillside hungry, and walk away full. You do not forget that.
